bmt-2023-geometry-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Points $W$, $X$, $Y$, and $Z$ are chosen inside a regular octagon so that four congruent rhombuses are formed, as shown in the diagram below. If the side length of the octagon is $1$, compute the area of quadrilateral $WXYZ$.
